correctness.rationale: Planar mixed-area identity gives sum of support values of the second polygon at all edge normals of first, including coincident normals. Reduction modulo 2pi/m partitions n normals into g copies of N=n/g equally spaced residues at steps 2pi/L, yielding the finite cosine sum sin(N*pi/L)/sin(pi/L)*cos(delta). This verifies the phase shift and folded E=A+2B cos(delta). Uniform rotation folds to delta uniform on [0,pi/L], giving the CDF, moments, and exact extremal gap. For equal-area polygons, B/A0 tends to 1 and a=pi/L tends to zero without a relative-growth condition, giving limiting range pi^2 and variance 4pi^4/45, and 1-U^2 normalized law. Independently compared 72 actual Minkowski convex-hull polygon areas against formula at fixed cases; this does not substitute for the universal residue proof.
